title.zh-CN: 故宫学刊2015 ·《慈宁宫大佛堂调查记》
title.en: Gugong Journal 2015 · Investigation of the Great Buddha Hall at Cining Palace

scope.zh-CN: 印刷301页图9–11为原位立剖面；303、308页说明形制及连莲座高2.25米；304页图13为具名释迦牟尼正面照。
scope.en: Printed p. 301, figures 9–11: original-position elevation and sections; pp. 303 and 308: form and 2.25 m figure-and-lotus height; p. 304, figure 13: named frontal photograph of Shakyamuni.

title.zh-CN: 故宫博物院院刊2014年第4期 ·《慈宁宫大佛堂考》
title.en: Palace Museum Journal, 2014 No. 4 · Study of the Great Buddha Hall at Cining Palace

scope.zh-CN: 印刷078–079页图7–8为具名平面和立面，支持北侧中轴原位关系；不证明当前陈设、游戏坐标或拟合承台尺寸。
scope.en: Printed pp. 078–079, figures 7–8: named plan and elevation supporting the original north-central placement, not current displays, game coordinates or fitted support dimensions.

zh-CN.heading: 历史主尊局部复原
zh-CN.identity: 本模型仅据故宫出版物复原原大佛堂北侧中轴的释迦牟尼坐像及莲座。原三世佛中另两尊未制作；1973年迁出后的照片不代表大佛堂当前陈设。
zh-CN.scale: 资料记坐像连莲座高2.25米，不含另行承台。模型承台高0.8米、位置、宽深及隐藏背面均为拟合，不是测绘尺寸。
zh-CN.limits: 面相、手指、细衣纹、莲瓣雕刻及漆金色为简化近似；本次单尊历史复原不表示整堂库存或完整内饰已核实。未核通用家具仍不生成，整体库存状态仍为未知，不代表空殿。
zh-CN.translation: 主尊英文名称及本段英文均为项目译文；建筑官名证据不等于文物英文名已核实。
zh-CN.review: 依据已阅读的官方出版物原文和图像；不是当前库存调查，也未重新核对全站历史来源。

en.heading: Partial reconstruction of the historical principal Buddha
en.identity: This model reconstructs only the seated Shakyamuni and lotus base on the original hall's north-central axis, using Palace Museum publications. The other two Buddhas of the original triad are not modeled. Photographs taken after the 1973 removal do not show the hall's current display.
en.scale: The published height of 2.25 m includes the seated figure and lotus base, not the separate support. The model's 0.8 m support, position, width, depth and hidden back are fitted, not surveyed dimensions.
en.limits: The face, fingers, fine robe folds, carved petals and lacquer-and-gold colors are simplified approximations. This single historical figure does not establish a verified whole-hall inventory or complete interior. Unverified generic furniture remains withheld; the overall inventory remains unknown, not confirmed empty.
en.translation: The figure's English name and this English text are project translations. Official naming evidence for the building does not verify an official English name for the artifact.
en.review: Based on the text and images of locally read official publications, not a current-inventory survey or a new review of all historical website sources.
